Name: Yet Another (Balanced) Quality Goods Mod
Description:
When increasing the quality or amount of machine products, you typically end up making about ~150% greater profit compared to vanilla (depending on the assortment of the quality of your input items). This mod does the same thing as other quality copy mods, but it also gives you a configurable price reduction to your artisan goods for those people who prefer a more vanilla balance. You can set it to [b]70% [/b]to match vanilla profit, set it to [b]100% [/b]to turn off price reduction entirely, or set it to something in between.

As a bonus, you will never lose money on any machine input, unlike in vanilla.

Additionally, Large Milks and Large Eggs will create a new item called Large Cheese/Large Goat Cheese and Large Mayonnaise. (After [b]Farming level 3[/b], these can be "cooked" into 2 of their smaller vanilla item if needed for recipes or bundles, etc.) If you prefer to keep the vanilla items, you can toggle the option [b]Large Animal Items[/b], and these will instead create [b]2[/b] cheeses/mayos with quality retained.

Utility items such as [b]oil [/b]and [b]coffee [/b]will not copy quality, but instead have a chance to [b]double[/b] their output, according to vanilla input. They also have a reduced price to balance out the increased output.

My priority for compat is my own mods, and mods that I play with. If you really want compatibility for a certain mod, you can [url=https://github.com/6480k/6480-Stardew-Mods/tree/main/%5BCP%5D%20Yet%20Another%20(Balanced)%20Quality%20Goods%20Mod]submit a pull request on Github[/url].

The Large Cheese/Large Mayo item idea was inspired by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Zeronacer/mods]Zeronacer's[/url] mod to do the same thing, though it seems to have been hidden for now.
